stem: A moisture sensor near the container edge reads dry while hand checks near the active root mass remain moist. What is the best response?
choices: Irrigate from the edge reading because the driest sensor location should define the schedule for the entire container
Move all sensors to the container edge so every plant is managed from the location that dries fastest after irrigation and the room uses one consistent sensor position
Average the edge reading with room humidity to create a combined value that better represents plant water demand
Evaluate sensor placement and spatial moisture variation before deciding which location represents the managed root zone
rationale: Root-zone moisture can vary spatially. A sensor should represent the zone being managed, and conflicting locations should trigger evaluation of placement and distribution rather than an automatic irrigation response.
